Subject: Request: IR artifacts and timeline for transient auth event (FinVexa)

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. During our security review we surfaced a transient authentication anomaly that coincided with a spike in rate-limited requests from our test tenant on 2028-02-28. Procurement is asking for a short IR bundle (for due diligence) so we can close the security checklist before contract signature.

Could you please provide the following by EOD Wednesday 2028-03-07 if possible:
- Incident timeline (first detection, mitigation steps, closure)
- Redacted log extracts showing affected request IDs (minimal scope)
- Short IR executive summary (1 page) describing root cause and remediation
- SOC 2 / SIG control mapping that is relevant to auth and logging for hosted customers

We understand redaction and legal review may be needed. If you can send an initial bundle and a plan for any outstanding items (and expected delivery dates), that would be ideal. If you need an NDA or a remediation call, we can set aside time—Mike (procurement) is CC'd for scheduling.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Security
FinVexa
